entities.summary: Mordecai Aaron Günzburg, also known by the acronym Remag (רמא״ג) and the pen name Yonah ben Amitai, was a Lithuanian Jewish writer, translator, and educator. He was a leading member of the Haskalah in Vilnius, and is regarded as the "Father of Hebrew Prose."
